_readme: The proof sheet and the day are built from this file. To add a photograph: put name.webp and name.jpg in the img folder, add an entry to frames (id, file, w, h, alt, title, time, caption), and optionally a moment that points at it by id. No code change. target is the number of frames the finished sheet should hold.

frames.title: Getting ready
frames.alt: A wedding dress hanging in a tall window, daylight through old curtains.
frames.caption: The room before everyone arrives, and a few minutes that belong only to you.

frames.title: The details
frames.alt: A bouquet of white roses on a stone sill.
frames.caption: Flowers, rings, stationery. The small things you spent months choosing.

frames.title: The vows
frames.alt: Two hands joined during the vows, a book open behind.
frames.caption: Hands, faces and the pause before the words.

frames.title: Golden hour
frames.alt: A couple walking hand in hand through long grass towards a castle, low evening sun.
frames.caption: Ten minutes away from everyone, with the light low and nothing to organise.

moments.title: Getting ready
moments.text: The room before everyone arrives. A dress by the window, and a few minutes that belong only to you.

moments.title: The details
moments.text: Flowers, rings, stationery. The small things you spent months choosing, photographed once and done well.

moments.title: The vows
moments.text: Seen from where the guests sit and from where you stand. Hands, faces, the pause before the words.

moments.title: Golden hour
moments.text: Ten minutes away from everyone, with the light low and nothing to organise.
